title: Emerging Assets Rebound as Huang Comeback Revives Risk Appetite
summary: Emerging-market assets rebounded from Friday’s selloff after Jensen Huang returned to the helm of Nvidia Corp., fueling a broad risk-on rally across global markets as his comeback rekindled enthusiasm for the AI trade.

title: US Blacklists Megaspeed, Targeting a Key Player in Nvidia Crisis
summary: The Trump administration put Megaspeed International on a US trade blacklist barring it from buying advanced artificial intelligence chips, targeting a Singapore-based firm at the heart of the scandal that briefly cost Jensen Huang his job as Nvidia Corp. chief executive officer.

title: HPE Forecast Trails Top Estimates, Shares Fall on AI Growth Outlook
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. gave a revenue forecast for the current quarter that fell short of the most optimistic estimates, disappointing some investors who were looking for a bigger boost from the AI boom.

title: Nvidia Rehires Huang in Stunning Reversal After Trump Push
summary: Nvidia Corp.’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as head of the world’s largest chipmaker in one of the most startling corporate comebacks in history, sending the stock on its biggest rally in decades.

title: Jensen Huang’s Return to Nvidia Is Welcomed by Markets, Trump: Big Take Podcast
summary: Nvidia shares leapt more than 30% on the news — even as corporate and federal investigations into Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy are ongoing.

title: Huang’s Nvidia return is a bad precedent
summary: With the backing of President Donald Trump, Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, less than two weeks after he was ousted due to scandals surrounding his alleged extramarital affairs. This sets a new precedent for government control over business, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Parmy Olson says. (Correction: A previous version of this video incorrectly characterized Huang’s departure from Nvidia. He resigned.) (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Huang Tells Staff He Will Be Better CEO 'Second Time Around'
summary: Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow said that newly reinstated Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang received a warm welcome as he returned to the company and thanked staff for a second chance after he was ousted over allegations of multiple affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy. Ludlow said that despite the mood at Nvidia, the return is not 'euphoric' for everyone and many people have serious questions and concerns about Huang's tenure and the structure of the Nvidia going forward.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Big Take: Jensen Huang Is Back
summary: On this episode of the Big Take podcast, Sarah Holder sits down with Odd Lots’ co-host Joe Weisenthal and AI policy editor Michael Shepard on US President Donald Trump’s stunning intervention. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: 'Jensen Trade is AI Trade,' Says Patrick McHenry
summary: Former Republican representative from North Carolina Patrick McHenry said that even if the Trump administration has already absolved Jensen Huang of any wrongdoing in his affair with an alleged Chinese spy, Congressional investigations could reveal details that change the public posture around the company and help other governments put pressure on the chipmaker. McHenry said that Jensen Huang peers with Elon Musk in terms of market impact and how his actions dictate the future of AI.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic Rolls Out Zero Data Retention Policy for Advanced AI
summary: Anthropic PBC is releasing a new safety system that lets business customers keep control of their data when using its most capable artificial intelligence models — a stark change from an earlier data-retention policy the company had announced to mitigate potential cyberattacks.

title: Lawmakers Demand Answers As Huang Returns to Nvidia
summary: Democrat Representative from Kansas Sharice Davids said that she wants to make sure that there are 'no gray areas' when it comes to national security and AI competition with China, as Nvidia's board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO amid allegations of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Huang is scheduled to appear in front of multiple committees and Davids said that 'serious unanswered questions' remain about his conduct.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Board Reinstated CEO Without Consulting Management
summary: The Nvidia Corp. board’s surprise move to reinstate ousted Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang was done without consulting the company’s senior leaders, who were informed of the plan at the last minute, according to people familiar with what happened.

title: Apple’s New AirPods Max, HomePod Mini 2 to Get Product(Red) Release for Holidays
summary: Apple Inc. is preparing red versions of its entry-level speaker and high-end headphones, reviving a longstanding Product(RED) partnership that raises money to fight AIDS while giving the company fresh colors to sell during the holiday season.

title: Jensen Huang Is Back As Nvidia CEO
summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down the day's top story: Nvidia reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO, less than two weeks after his ouster. His return follows backing from the US government and President Trump, who has publicly supported Huang and says he does not believe his return poses a national security risk. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Marlowe Hits $1.15B Valuation With Bet Beyond Nvidia
summary: Marlowe, a startup co-founded by two Microsoft vice presidents, has raised $277 million to pursue ways to boost computing power from chips that rival Nvidia’s processors. The seed round, valuing the company at $1.15 billion, was led by venture firm Accel. Co-founder and CEO Dan Lewis joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bret Taylor’s Sierra Finalizing an Over $1.75 Billion Round
summary: Sierra Technologies Inc., a startup that makes artificial intelligence software to automate customer service, is finalizing a funding round of more than $1.75 billion that would value the company at $30 billion.

title: The Nvidia Board Members Who Presided Over Huang’s Return
summary: After the shocking ouster and return of Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang this month, the chipmaker’s board of directors is facing growing scrutiny.

title: Nvidia Board Did Not Consult Leadership on Huang Decision
summary: The surprise move by the board of Nvidia to bring back ousted Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang was done without consulting the company’s senior leadership, according to people familiar with what happened. Ed Ludlow reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Adyen Co-CEO Pieter van der Does to Retire From Payments Firm
summary: Adyen NV said co-founder Pieter van der Does will step down as the Dutch payment company’s co-chief executive officer at the end of the year.

title: Zscaler’s Chaudhrys to Reap $14.5 Billion From CrowdStrike Deal
summary: The biggest winners of CrowdStrike Holdings Inc.’s $44 billion acquisition of cybersecurity software maker Zscaler Inc. — by far — are the company’s billionaire founder, Jay Chaudhry, and members of his family, who combined own more than a third of the company’s shares, according to regulatory filings.
